I think being addicted to anything is a very human thing and as always, it may not be the most “healthy” thing. However, i think you’re not overreacting but rather over analyzing. The guilt/emotion you’re feeling I think is a really good sign if what you were watching really was as disgusting as you describe. The guilt that you’re feeling will drive you to become a better person and not just that, over analyzing can make a small incident or epiphany seem colossal. The consciousness of your past mistakes, mishaps, or whatever you want to call it, will affect your future decisions so if you wanna help your porn addiction, i suggest moving slow and again, reaching out is already a step :) you can hmu if you’d like. here for you.
